public_rationale: Marcus said OpenAI had not yet turned a profit. Reuters and The Decoder, citing documents OpenAI shared with shareholders, reported that in Q1 2026 OpenAI had a $9.3 billion operating loss and a net loss of over $21.3 billion. Part of the net loss came from a paper charge, but the operating loss alone shows no profit. The second part of his sentence, that it is unclear whether OpenAI ever will profit, is a judgment, and nothing found shows profitability was assured. The factual part holds.
limitations: The financials are leaked or shareholder-shared figures reported by the press, not audited public filings.
The 'not clear they ever will' clause is opinion and is not scored on its own.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible reporting shows OpenAI posted an operating or net profit in a reported period before June 10, 2026.
